name: 🥩 Steakhouse Steak & Fries
tagline: A hard-seared flat iron with garlic butter and crispy parmesan fries: steakhouse at home.

items.name: Kosher salt and coarse black pepper
Thyme or rosemary, if we have it

steps.text: Take the steak out 30 minutes early. Pat it very dry and salt it well on both sides.
Oven to the fries' temperature. Spread the fries in one layer on a sheet pan so they crisp.
With 12 minutes left on the fries, heat a cast-iron skillet over high until smoking. Add oil, then the steak. Don't move it for 4 minutes.
Flip, add butter, garlic and herbs. Tilt the pan and spoon the foaming butter over the steak until 130°F inside for medium-rare.
Rest the steak on a board 8 minutes. Pour the garlic butter over the top.
Slice thin against the grain. Season with pepper and serve with the fries.

kid_jobs.job: Spread the fries out so no two touch
Pat the steak dry with paper towels
Read the meat thermometer and call the number
Set the table and pour the drinks

chef_tip: Dry steak + a smoking-hot pan + don't touch it. Then let it rest 8 minutes. Skip the rest and the juice ends up on the board instead of in the steak.
make_ahead: Salt the steak in the morning and leave it uncovered in the fridge: it seasons deeper and sears better.
leftovers: Steak salad on spring mix, or steak and cheese on a demi baguette.
swaps: Potato puffs or sweet potato fries
serve_with: A Caesar salad kit or green beans
heads_up: Steak out of the fridge 30 min before; turn the fan on, it'll smoke.

game_plan.what: Steak out of the fridge, patted dry and salted.
Oven on; kids spread the fries in one layer.
Cast iron on high until smoking; steak in.
Flip, butter, garlic, baste. Steak out to rest.
Fries out, steak sliced thin, garlic butter on top.
